question: Will SpaceXAI rename itself to SpaceXSI (or another "SI" name) by end of 2026?
resolution_criteria:
Background: On Sep 29, 2026 Trump signed the executive order "Inaugurating the Era of

Super Intelligence", directing federal agencies to say "Super Intelligence"/"SI" instead

of "AI". On Oct 4, 2026, asked on X whether SpaceXAI could be renamed SpaceXSI, Elon Musk

replied "Yes, we will make that change." He gave no date. At market creation the official account is still @SpaceXAI.


Resolves YES if, before Dec 31, 2026 11:59 PM ET, EITHER of these happens:

1. X account: the official X account of SpaceX's AI unit (currently @SpaceXAI) changes

   its handle OR its display name to an SI name.

2. Website: the unit's official website (currently x.ai, or wherever it redirects) shows

   an SI name as the company name in its header logo or browser page title.


"SI name" = the unit's name with "AI" replaced by "SI", "Super Intelligence" or

"Superintelligence". Spacing, capitalization and punctuation don't matter.

Counts: SpaceXSI, SpaceX SI, SpaceX Super Intelligence, SpaceX Superintelligence.


Does NOT count:

- Statements of intent, including Musk's Oct 4 reply or any later "we will..." post

- Musk's personal account, employees' accounts, or third parties using the name

- News headlines saying it was "renamed" unless 1 or 2 has actually happened

  (some outlets already wrote "renames" about the Oct 4 announcement)

- Renaming only a product (e.g. Grok) rather than the unit itself

- A rename to anything without SI/Super Intelligence (e.g. plain "SpaceX") -> NO


A change that is later reverted still counts, as long as it is documented by a

Wayback Machine/archive.today snapshot or a news report saying the account or site

changed.

Resolves NO if neither 1 nor 2 has happened by the deadline.

# SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI rename: research notes, as of 2026-10-09

**Summary:** As of 2026-10-09 the only thing on record is Musk's Oct 4 promise ("we will make that change"), and it has no date. Reports through Oct 5 say the X account had not changed. I could not confirm the current state of the X account or the website directly. In the last precedent, xAI's rename to SpaceXAI, the X handle changed about two months after Musk signaled it.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question is decided by the official X account (currently @SpaceXAI), its handle or display name, and by the header logo or page title on x.ai.
- 2026-10-09: I could not check the live X account or x.ai myself. My page fetches were refused by the network proxy, so the information below comes from search-result snippets of news articles.
- 2026-10-05: Reuters-based coverage said the company's X account "was unchanged at the time." [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/spacex-renaming-ai-unit-spacexsi-112228799.html); [Cybernews](https://cybernews.com/news/musk-spacexai-rename-spacexsi/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing published by 2026-10-09 shows the handle, display name or website has changed. The question is not settled.
- Several outlets used "renames" headlines, which do not count under the resolution criteria. Examples: [Fox Business](https://www.foxbusiness.com/technology/elon-musk-rebrands-spacexai-following-trump-directive), [Khaleej Times](https://www.khaleejtimes.com/world/americas/musk-renames-spacexai-to-spacexsi-trumps-super-intelligence), [Tech-Insider](https://tech-insider.org/musk-renames-spacexai-spacexsi-trump-order-2026/).
- Coverage describes Musk's posts as informal, not a corporate filing, so the name change is not legally final. [Tech-Insider](https://tech-insider.org/musk-renames-spacexai-spacexsi-trump-order-2026/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-05: Reports say Musk gave no timeline or method. He also posted "SpaceX is a super intelligence company." [Fast Company](https://www.fastcompany.com/91618420/elon-musk-spacexai-rebrand); [CoinGape](https://coingape.com/news/stocks/spcx-stock-price-eyes-rally-as-elon-musk-calls-spacex-a-super-intelligence-firm/); [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/10/05/musk-to-follow-trump-and-rebrand-spacexai-as-spacexsi); [The Star](https://www.thestar.com.my/tech/tech-news/2026/10/05/musk-says-he-will-rename-spacexai-to-spacexsi)
- 2026-10-05: Yahoo Finance reported that SpaceX (SPCX) shares rose about 5% on the news. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/spacex-climbs-5-musk-renames-144603092.html)
- 2026-10-04: Asked on X about renaming, Musk replied "Yes, we will make that change." [Seeking Alpha](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4650066-spacexai-to-be-rebranded-as-spacexsi-elon-musk-says); [Not a Tesla App](https://www.notateslaapp.com/news/4770/musk-spacexai-will-be-renamed-spacexsi-dropping-ai)
- 2026-09-29: Trump signed the order "Inaugurating the Era of Super Intelligence." It covers federal communications only and creates no new regulation. [KATV](https://katv.com/news/nation-world/trumps-executive-order-replaces-artificial-intelligence-with-super-intelligence-china-industrial-revolution-industry-elon-musk-mark-zuckerberg-politics-president-donald-trump)

## 4. Base rates and precedent
- The closest precedent is the rename from xAI to SpaceXAI.
  - 2026-02: SpaceX completed its acquisition of xAI. [Gigazine](https://gigazine.net/gsc_news/en/20260707-xai-change-spacexai/)
  - 2026-05: Musk signaled that xAI would be dissolved as a separate company. [Gigazine](https://gigazine.net/gsc_news/en/20260707-xai-change-spacexai/)
  - 2026-07-06: The @xai handle became @SpaceXAI, with a new logo and the post "We are now @SpaceXAI." That was roughly 6 to 9 weeks after Musk's signal. [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2209300/xai-now-officially-spacexai/); [Design Compass](https://designcompass.org/en/2026/07/08/xai-spacexai-new-logo/)
- What this suggests:
  - The company has shown it will change the handle and branding quickly and in public.
  - The SpaceXSI rename would be its second name change in about three months. [Yellow](https://yellow.com/news/spacexai-finished-musk-spacexsi-replace-name)
  - Changing an X handle or display name costs almost nothing, and X is Musk's own platform.
  - Musk has a history of promises that arrive late or never, but I found no systematic base rate for that.
- At the time of the July rename, the new logo had not yet appeared in the company's filings. This suggests website and legal changes can lag behind the X account. [Free Press Journal](https://www.freepressjournal.in/tech/elon-musks-xai-rebrands-to-spacexai-unveils-new-logo)

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-10-05: A Polymarket market, "Will SpaceXAI officially rename itself to SpaceXSI by...?", was listed on PredScope. In that snapshot it had about $23K in volume, and the leading outcome was "October 31" at about 22%.
  - That market's criteria also accept "XSI," so they differ somewhat from this question's.
  - I could not open the page to see the other date buckets or current prices. [PredScope](https://predscope.com/event/will-spacexai-officially-rename-itself-to-spacexsi-byptptpt)
- I found no Kalshi market. I found no Manifold market on this exact question dated on or before Oct 9.

## 6. Upcoming events before the deadline
- There are no scheduled events. Any update would likely be a surprise post on X, as with the July 6 rebrand.
- Things to watch:
  - The @SpaceXAI handle and display name.
  - The x.ai page title and logo.
  - Any new Grok or model launch that could be paired with a rebrand.
  - Further federal follow-up on the order, which could add pressure to make the change.

- Oct 5: he posted "SpaceX is a super intelligence company."
  - July 6: the company already completed a public handle change quickly.

  - There is political alignment with the Sept 29 executive order.
- **For No:**
  - Musk gave no timeline (Oct 5 reports).
  - It would be the second rename in about 3 months for a now-public company (SPCX), and there may be legal or branding friction.
  - "SpaceX is a super intelligence company" hints the unit might simply be folded into "SpaceX", which resolves No.
  - The Oct 5 Polymarket snapshot showed only about 22% for "by October 31". Its wording differs slightly (it also accepts "XSI") and it has thin volume, about $23K.
  - The comment could have been offhand, and political enthusiasm can fade.

(e) **Scenarios.**
- **No:** Musk's attention moves on, and the SpaceXAI branding stays in place or is quietly merged into plain "SpaceX". No SI name appears on the handle or the site by Dec 31.
- **Yes:** Paired with a Grok launch or a news cycle in November, @SpaceXAI posts "We are now @SpaceXSI" with a new logo, as with the July 6 rebrand.

(f) **Final adjustment.** I start near 50%.
- I move down for the status quo weighting, the market's modest Oct 31 pricing, the merge-into-SpaceX risk and Musk's habit of loose follow-through.
- I move up slightly because the change is trivially easy and he made an explicit "yes."
- I land a bit below even.

Probability: 42%
